what: When you hover a photo, or a card or list row holding a photo, the photo dims to .4 opacity, flashes bright at 1.1x at the 25% mark, then returns to place over 1.2s ease-in-out — like a camera flash going off once. On release it goes straight back to normal

options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo to make shine (child). Apply it to the whole card and attach it to the photo inside

use: Post title
note: Since this is a CSS-only part, values come in as --fx-* variables. Not applied on touch devices (no hover). The original lays two tilted ink-black bands (.photo_animation:before/after) over the photo, but they have no content so they are invisible — not included.

from.where: shared.css .yc-flash (photos in Home featured post cards · News grid · Classroom news rows)
